_comment: Real example, instantiated over a critical-flow domain (a critical-flow domain): 10 invariants INV-01..10 (PAY-INV-01..10 there). Copy to config/invariants-checks.json (or pass --config to lib/domain_invariants.py) and adjust the patterns to your own code. Some signals from the original script had no clean generic form and are approximated here: INV-03 originally looked at a single named file (the tokenization repository); this version uses 'scope: money' instead. INV-04 originally distinguished an enum's declaration from its usage site; this version only detects mentions of the identifier, without that distinction.

INV-01.note: concurrency guards + idempotency key construction: idempotency across all production code, guards only on money paths

INV-03.note: generic approximation: status?.copy on money paths (the original looked at a single tokenization repository file, not expressible in a generic scope)

INV-04.note: journal (*Journal*.kt) expected at NONE today; reconcile(/RecoveredAfterRestart are the evidence of real recovery (without distinguishing declaration from usage site, unlike the original script)

INV-05.note: presence of install(HttpRequestRetry) in code (comments excluded) as evidence of transport retry

INV-08.note: spots that format money with String.format("%.2f", ...) instead of minorUnits

INV-10.note: android.util.Log (import or call) inside money paths
